_comment: One entry per decided row of matrix-prereq-findings.json. Absent means status=open.
declined REQUIRES a reason; deferred REQUIRES an `until` trigger. The generator rejects either
without one, and --check rejects a decision naming a row that no longer exists.
AND --check ASSERTS EACH STATUS AGAINST THE TREE, not against this file. A row marked done whose
defect signature still matches is a FAILURE, not a green: that is the exact hole the PR-570 ledger
had, where ten rows sat accepted while the change was already shipped.

D01.note: all 15 gpu_us pass timers Budget -> Detail; the consumer learns the RANK case

_correction: R05 was briefly marked done against commit 72ad0000. WRONG ROW: R05 is
lighting.gather.calc_outside_loaded, which is still open; 72ad0000 hoisted
render.drawable.parts.cached and the six lighting.gather.* counters, and the sweep -- which ran
AFTER that commit -- correctly found no row for them because they were already fixed.
It passed --check silently because R05 carries no signature. That is exactly why the UNVERIFIABLE
count is printed on every run: a row nothing can check is a row that can be mislabelled, and the
number is the honest measure of how much of this ledger is asserted rather than verified.
